mentl/c00a871:
binop_loop calls check_pcompose_layout(tokens, p, op_span, saw_newline, k)
for every binop token; the fn dispatches on TGtLt and is a no-op otherwise.

For ><:
- prev_non_newline scans back over TNewline; if the preceding non-newline
  token isn't TRParen, emit E_BranchNotParenthesized on the left side.
- skip_ws past the >< token; if next non-newline isn't TLParen, emit
  E_BranchNotParenthesized on the right side.
- If saw_newline_before AND the immediately-following token isn't
  TNewline, emit E_OperatorIsolation (Form A requires newline both
  before AND after the operator).

Closes Stage 1 #142 cascade chunks E_BranchNotParenthesized + E_OperatorIsolation.
E_MixedShapeBranches + E_ParallelComposeArity remain as named peer
follow-ups (require post-parse chain analysis the op-local fn can't see).
mentl/c028f75:
Ownership is an effect, not a separate analysis. `own` parameters are
linear (used at most once) — tracked through the existing TypeEnv
alongside effect rows. `ref` parameters are scoped (cannot escape).
No separate ownership module. No lifetime annotations. The effect
system IS the borrow checker.

Checker changes:
- TypeEnv gains linear_bindings/ref_bindings (2 fields, not a module)
- check_fn_decl registers own/ref params during inference
- infer_expr Var arm tracks consumption, errors on second use
- If/else branch merging: snapshot/restore/merge linear state
- Ref-escape check on function return position
- Teaching hint when own param never consumed

New files:
- docs/specs/ownership-design.md — full design spec
- examples/ownership_enforced.lux — what must compile (golden)
- examples/ownership_errors.lux — what must fail (spec)
- Lux-first sketch in std/compiler/checker.lux

Docs updated:
- INSIGHTS.md: "Three Tiers of Effect Compilation", "Self-Similar Language"
- ROADMAP.md: dependency lattice, hard problems, custom backend rationale
sonido/c004e07:
A new `com.sonido.graph-player` CLAP plugin (separate cdylib alongside the 19
per-effect plugins) that wraps a whole rig instead of one effect: a PatchPlayer
driven by six macro params, A/B morph position/speed, input/master gain, and
bypass — stable CLAP ids 0x1000–0x1030, never renumbered.

Its state IS the patch JSON the Studio exports (GraphState = patch + param
values), so "Export as CLAP" loads directly, and the rig sounds identical in
the DAW and on the pedal (both wrap a PatchPlayer). Headless core — params,
state, audio, latency — loadable and automatable in any host today; the editor
GUI (reusing macro_panel/morph_bar) is a follow-up.

Builds the libsonido_graph_player cdylib; 4 tests (stable/unique param ids,
patch+state roundtrip, the exported-blob equivalence between sector and JSON).
Full `make verify` green with the plugin in the gate.
sonido/c0a5617:
This commit brings together a major set of improvements across the GUI,
audio processing, plugin, and documentation.

GUI Usability Improvements (sonido-gui)
---------------------------------------
- Preset loading: Hard reset implementation — stops audio, rebuilds entire
  effect chain to match preset (add/remove effects as needed), applies all
  parameters, and restarts audio for exact preset reconstruction.
- Input gain safety: Default changed from 0 dB to -120 dB to prevent feedback
  on startup; range now -120 to +20 dB; explicit user action required to
  enable microphone input.
- Level meter: Upgraded to Ableton-style combined Peak/RMS visualization.
  RMS bar with gradient (green→yellow→red); Peak overlay in brighter colors
  (thresholds >0.7→>0.95); white peak-hold line.
- Drag-and-drop reordering: Single-motion effect slot rearrangement with
  translucent drop target indicator; replaces incremental arrow-step system.
- NaN guard: Audio input samples validated; non-finite values replaced with
  silence to prevent corruption.

Buffer Management and Real-Time Monitoring (sonido-gui)
-------------------------------------------------------
- Configurable buffer size: Interactive status-bar selector with presets
  (256/512/1024/2048/4096). Changes restart audio with hardware validation.
- Buffer overrun detection: Real-time processing-time monitoring vs. buffer
  duration. After 3 consecutive overruns, effects are automatically bypassed
  to preserve audio stability. Overrun counter shown in status bar with
  color-coded warnings (yellow/red).
- CPU usage monitoring: Sparkline graph (custom-drawn, last 60 frames) shows
  CPU trend. Color-coded: green (<80%), yellow (80-100%), red (>100%).
- Buffer health indicators: Status tracking (0=good,1=warning,2=critical),
  60-frame history, and alert levels integrated throughout metering system.
- Adaptive processing: Automatic effects bypass on sustained overruns;
  recovery when processing returns to normal.
